<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CarService" name="Car Service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_CarService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_PreviousServiceSuccessful</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ServiceDue</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Registration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ServiceOrFine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ThirtyDays</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FineCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Fined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NextServiceScheduled</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveServiceVisit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PayThroughApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_CarNotRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterProblems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RepairCar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextServiceTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PreviousServiceSuccessful" name="Previous service successful"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ServiceDue" name="Service becomes necessary">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_ServiceDue">
        <bpmn:timeDate xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">nextServiceTime</bpmn:timeDate>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether the car is still registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registration" name="Car registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" name="Wait for service visit or 30 days" gatewayDirection="Diverging" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveServiceVisit" name="Customer arrives for service"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ThirtyDays" name="30 days pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FineCustomer" name="Fine customer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Fined" name="Customer fined"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CarNotRegistered" name="Car not registered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesSplit" name="Repair and status updates" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdates" name="Send status updates via email"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" name="Receive status updates via email"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesJoin" name="Repair and updates complete" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl" name="Enter successful repair and Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" name="Enter time for next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NextServiceScheduled" name="Next service time entered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ServiceDue" sourceRef="StartEvent_PreviousServiceSuccessful" targetRef="Event_ServiceDue"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ServiceDue_Check" sourceRef="Event_ServiceDue" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Registration" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registration" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">carRegistered = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="Not registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registration" targetRef="EndEvent_CarNotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Wait" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ServiceVisit" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" targetRef="Task_ReceiveServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_ThirtyDays" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" targetRef="Event_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThirtyDays_Fine" sourceRef="Event_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_FineCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fine_End" sourceRef="Task_FineCustomer" targetRef="EndEvent_Fined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ServiceVisit_EnterProblems" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveServiceVisit" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterProblems_Split" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Repair" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Join" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_ReceiveUpdates" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveUpdates_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairAndUpdatesJoin" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_RecordSuccess" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordSuccess_NextTime" sourceRef="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepairAndPickerl" targetRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextTime_End" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" targetRef="EndEvent_NextServiceScheduled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
